The '''Samarine Province'''<ref name="FftR">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> was a subsector of the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Samarine system/Legends|Samarine system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

[[Damualer Triac]] was located seven [[Parsec/Legends|kiloparsecs]] from the Samarine Province.<ref name="FftR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated during the development of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] that the Samarine and Valahari subsectors of the D'Astan sector present in the Online Companion were meant to be the Samarine and [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari Provinces]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 3.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-04-12}}</ref>
